_marker_recovery: The panel's markers overlap, so not all 49 appear as separate connected components. Only unambiguous single markers enter the comparison; the merged blobs are counted and left out.

set_match._reading: A mean delta near zero on BOTH axes means neither digitiser carries a uniform scale or origin error. The rms is the per-point agreement and is bounded below by the panels' own drawing precision: a 1 px marker-centroid error is ~68 AU on x and ~0.012 decades on y.
